prompt: Name a company that had crossed a trillion dollars in value by May 2026.
label: Final Dig
note: Dated on purpose: 'by May 2026' turns a live, ever-growing question into a fixed historical one, the same way a Wikipedia snapshot stays accurate forever once dated, even as the live page keeps changing. Verified against reporting as of that date: 14 current members plus PetroChina historically. A later refresh (moving the cutoff forward to catch Broadcom's successors) is a deliberate edit - new date, re-verify the list - not a live-tracking obligation the round is silently failing at between reviews. Also fixed: the near-misses below were filed as extras, implying they're still correct - none of them have crossed a trillion, so they're distractors with bust:true instead, same fix as the other four rounds in this game.

answers.name: Apple
answers.fact: First US company to reach a trillion, in August 2018, then first to two and to three.

answers.name: Microsoft
answers.fact: Crossed in 2019 on the back of enterprise cloud.

answers.name: Nvidia
answers.fact: Crossed in 2023, then became the first company ever worth five trillion.

answers.name: Amazon
answers.fact: Briefly crossed in 2018, fell back, and returned for good later.

answers.name: Alphabet
answers.fact: Crossed in 2020. The holding company Google built around itself in 2015.

answers.name: Tesla
answers.fact: Crossed in October 2021, the first carmaker ever to manage it.

answers.name: Meta
answers.fact: Crossed in 2021, while it was still called Facebook.

answers.name: Saudi Aramco
answers.fact: Crossed at its 2019 listing, the largest IPO in history.

answers.name: Berkshire Hathaway
answers.fact: Crossed in August 2024, the first US company outside tech to do it.

answers.name: Samsung
answers.fact: The Korean electronics group, and a recent arrival to the trillion club.

answers.name: TSMC
answers.fact: Makes the most advanced chips on Earth, for Nvidia and Apple alike.

answers.name: Broadcom
answers.fact: Crossed in December 2024 after its AI revenue more than tripled.

answers.name: Micron
answers.fact: A memory chip maker carried over the line by AI demand.

answers.name: SK Hynix
answers.fact: The Korean memory maker whose stock rose roughly tenfold in a year.

answers.name: PetroChina
answers.fact: Touched a trillion on its Shanghai debut in 2007 - the first company ever to do it.

distractors.name: OpenAI
distractors.note: Privately valued near a trillion, but never publicly traded at that level.

distractors.name: Eli Lilly
distractors.note: Came close on weight-loss drugs, but hasn't crossed a trillion.

distractors.name: Walmart
distractors.note: The largest company by revenue, but not by market value.

distractors.name: Exxon Mobil
distractors.note: Once the most valuable company in the world, long before a trillion was reachable.

distractors.name: JPMorgan Chase
distractors.note: The most valuable bank in the world, and still short of a trillion.
